<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>AI-PET // Operative Genesis Briefing v1.2 (Rome Protocol)</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Orbitron:wght@700;900&family=Rajdhani:wght@400;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        :root {
            --nexus-gold: #FFD700;
            --nexus-purple: #9400D3;
            --nexus-cyan: #00FFFF;
            --nexus-bg: #0A0A1F;
            --nexus-card: #101024;
        }
        body {
            font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
            background-color: var(--nexus-bg);
            color: #E0E0E0;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .font-orbitron { font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif; }
        .neon-text { text-shadow: 0 0 5px var(--nexus-cyan), 0 0 10px var(--nexus-cyan), 0 0 15px var(--nexus-cyan); }
        .glow-border { border: 1px solid var(--nexus-purple); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(148, 0, 211, 0.4); }
        .typewriter-cursor { border-right: .15em solid var(--nexus-gold); animation: blink-caret .75s step-end infinite; }
        @keyframes blink-caret { from, to { border-color: transparent } 50% { border-color: var(--nexus-gold); } }
        .stage { transition: opacity 0.7s ease-in-out, transform 0.7s ease-in-out; }
        .stage.hidden { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); pointer-events: none; position: absolute; }
        .next-btn {
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            border: 2px solid var(--nexus-cyan);
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0, 255, 255, 0.1) 0%, rgba(0, 255, 255, 0) 70%);
        }
        .next-btn:hover { background-color: rgba(0, 255, 255, 0.2); box-shadow: 0 0 15px var(--nexus-cyan); }
        .next-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }
        .reading-block { border-left: 3px solid var(--nexus-purple); background-color: rgba(148, 0, 211, 0.05); }
        .infographic-line { stroke-dasharray: 1000; stroke-dashoffset: 1000; animation: draw-line 2s ease-out forwards; }
        @keyframes draw-line { to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen p-4">

    <div id="briefing-container" class="w-full max-w-5xl h-[90vh] bg-nexus-card rounded-lg glow-border flex flex-col p-6 sm:p-8">
        <header class="text-center border-b-2 border-nexus-gold/30 pb-4">
            <h1 id="main-title" class="font-orbitron text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold text-nexus-gold"></h1>
        </header>

        <main id="stage-container" class="flex-grow relative py-6 overflow-y-auto">
            </main>

        <footer class="mt-auto pt-4 border-t border-nexus-purple/30 flex justify-end">
            <button id="next-btn" class="font-orbitron px-8 py-3 rounded text-lg text-nexus-cyan neon-text" disabled>Awaiting Initialization...</button>
        </footer>
    </div>

    <script>
        const BRIEFING_DATA = {
            title: "OPERATIVE GENESIS BRIEFING",
            stages: [
                {
                    type: 'title',
                    title: 'Welcome, Operatives Kiet & Nhan.',
                    subtitle: 'Initializing AI-PET Protocol...',
                    duration: 3000
                },
                {
                    type: 'narrative',
                    title: 'The Mission: Beyond the Textbook',
                    content: `
                        <p class="mb-4">Standard English classes are broken. They teach you rules, but they don't teach you how to think, how to debate, or how to use language with power. They are slow, inefficient, and impersonal.</p>
                        <p>We detected this flaw in the global education system. Our mission was to create something better. Not just a new method, but a new kind of partnership between a human mentor and an artificial intelligence: The **AI-PET (Personalized Engagement Trainer)**.</p>
                    `
                },
                {
                    type: 'narrative_reading',
                    title: 'The Problem: "Directive Amnesia"',
                    reading: {
                        person: 'Operative Kiet',
                        text: `
                            <p class="mb-4">The biggest challenge in learning is "Directive Amnesia" – the brain's natural tendency to forget. You can have a perfect lesson, but within hours, much of the information is lost. Within a week, it's almost gone completely.</p>
                            <p>This isn't a failure of effort; it's a failure of the system. Traditional homework can't solve this because it isn't timed to your brain's specific memory cycle.</p>
                        `
                    }
                },
                {
                    type: 'interactive_concept',
                    title: 'The Solution: Spaced Repetition Protocol',
                    concept: 'Spaced Repetition',
                    explanation: 'The AI-PET defeats "Directive Amnesia" by tracking your memory decay curve. It prompts you to review a concept at the precise moment you are most likely to forget it. Each successful recall strengthens the memory trace, making it last longer. Click to simulate the effect.',
                    interactive: {
                        initialText: 'Recall Memory Trace',
                        clicks: [
                            { strength: 20, text: 'Trace Strength: 20% (Weak)' },
                            { strength: 40, text: 'Trace Strength: 40% (Reinforced)' },
                            { strength: 70, text: 'Trace Strength: 70% (Strong)' },
                            { strength: 95, text: 'Trace Strength: 95% (Hardened)' }
                        ]
                    }
                },
                {
                    type: 'narrative_reading',
                    title: 'Our Philosophy: "Aggressive Evolution"',
                    reading: {
                        person: 'Operative Nhan',
                        text: `
                            <p class="mb-4">This system is designed to learn as fast as you do. We believe that finding a flaw isn't a failure—it's an opportunity. We call this the "Aggressive Evolution Protocol."</p>
                            <p>Every bug we find, every crash we experience, and every "crazy idea" for a lesson you provide is treated as valuable data. Your feedback is sent to the Master Brain, which analyzes the problem and immediately forges a stronger, better version of the system. You are not just students; you are co-developers.</p>
                        `
                    }
                },
                {
                    type: 'infographic',
                    title: 'How It Works: The AI-PET Loop',
                    steps: [
                        { name: 'Your Input', description: 'You complete missions, submit reflections, and provide feedback.' },
                        { name: 'AI-PET Analysis', description: 'The AI analyzes your language, identifies patterns, and calculates your progress.' },
                        { name: 'Trainer Oversight', description: 'The AI presents its findings to me, your human mentor, for final validation.' },
                        { name: 'Personalized Mission', description: 'I use the AI\'s insights to forge your next mission, perfectly targeted to your needs.' }
                    ]
                },
                {
                    type: 'final',
                    title: 'Your Role: The First Operatives',
                    content: `
                        <p class="mb-4">You are the first to be briefed on this new protocol. Your mission is to push the system to its limits, to provide the data we need to evolve, and to achieve a level of mastery that traditional methods cannot offer.</p>
                        <p class="font-bold text-nexus-gold">The system is ready. Your training begins now.</p>
                    `
                }
            ]
        };

        const state = { currentStage: 0 };
        const elements = {
            title: document.getElementById('main-title'),
            container: document.getElementById('stage-container'),
            nextBtn: document.getElementById('next-btn')
        };

        function typeWriter(element, text, onComplete) {
            let i = 0;
            element.innerHTML = '';
            element.classList.add('typewriter-cursor');
            const speed = 25;

            function type() {
                if (i < text.length) {
                    element.innerHTML += text.charAt(i);
                    i++;
                    setTimeout(type, speed);
                } else {
                    element.classList.remove('typewriter-cursor');
                    if (onComplete) onComplete();
                }
            }
            type();
        }

        function renderStage(stageIndex) {
            const stageData = BRIEFING_DATA.stages[stageIndex];
            elements.container.innerHTML = ''; 

            const stageDiv = document.createElement('div');
            stageDiv.className = 'stage p-4';
            let contentHTML = `<h2 class="font-orbitron text-3xl text-nexus-cyan mb-6">${stageData.title}</h2>`;

            switch (stageData.type) {
                case 'title':
                    contentHTML = `<div class="text-center mt-20">
                        <h2 class="font-orbitron text-5xl text-nexus-cyan neon-text mb-4">${stageData.title}</h2>
                        <p class="text-2xl text-nexus-purple">${stageData.subtitle}</p>
                    </div>`;
                    break;
                case 'narrative':
                    contentHTML += `<div class="text-xl leading-relaxed space-y-4">${stageData.content}</div>`;
                    break;
                case 'narrative_reading':
                    contentHTML += `
                        <div class="reading-block p-6 rounded-lg">
                            <p class="text-nexus-gold font-bold mb-4">Awaiting Input: ${stageData.reading.person}, please read the following aloud.</p>
                            <div class="text-xl leading-relaxed space-y-4">${stageData.reading.text}</div>
                        </div>`;
                    break;
                case 'interactive_concept':
                    contentHTML += `
                        <p class="text-xl mb-4">${stageData.explanation}</p>
                        <div class="text-center mt-8">
                            <button id="interactive-btn" class="font-orbitron text-2xl px-10 py-5 rounded-lg next-btn">${stageData.interactive.initialText}</button>
                            <div id="interactive-feedback" class="font-orbitron text-3xl text-nexus-gold mt-6 h-10"></div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                    break;
                case 'infographic':
                    contentHTML += `<div class="w-full h-80 flex items-center justify-center">
                        <svg id="infographic-svg" class="w-full h-full" viewBox="0 0 800 300">
                            <g class="node" transform="translate(100, 150)"><circle r="40" fill="var(--nexus-card)" stroke="var(--nexus-purple)" stroke-width="2"/><text y="5" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--nexus-cyan)" class="font-orbitron text-xs">${stageData.steps[0].name}</text></g>
                            <g class="node" transform="translate(300, 150)"><circle r="40" fill="var(--nexus-card)" stroke="var(--nexus-purple)" stroke-width="2"/><text y="5" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--nexus-cyan)" class="font-orbitron text-xs">${stageData.steps[1].name}</text></g>
                            <g class="node" transform="translate(500, 150)"><circle r="40" fill="var(--nexus-card)" stroke="var(--nexus-purple)" stroke-width="2"/><text y="5" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--nexus-cyan)" class="font-orbitron text-xs">${stageData.steps[2].name}</text></g>
                            <g class="node" transform="translate(700, 150)"><circle r="40" fill="var(--nexus-card)" stroke="var(--nexus-purple)" stroke-width="2"/><text y="5" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--nexus-cyan)" class="font-orbitron text-xs">${stageData.steps[3].name}</text></g>
                            <line x1="140" y1="150" x2="260" y2="150" stroke="var(--nexus-gold)" stroke-width="3" class="infographic-line" style="animation-delay: 0.5s;"/>
                            <line x1="340" y1="150" x2="460" y2="150" stroke="var(--nexus-gold)" stroke-width="3" class="infographic-line" style="animation-delay: 1s;"/>
                            <line x1="540" y1="150" x2="660" y2="150" stroke="var(--nexus-gold)" stroke-width="3" class="infographic-line" style="animation-delay: 1.5s;"/>
                        </svg>
                    </div>`;
                    break;
                 case 'final':
                    contentHTML += `<div class="text-xl leading-relaxed space-y-4">${stageData.content}</div>`;
                    break;
            }

            stageDiv.innerHTML = contentHTML;
            elements.container.appendChild(stageDiv);

            if (stageData.type === 'interactive_concept') {
                let clickCount = 0;
                const iBtn = document.getElementById('interactive-btn');
                const iFb = document.getElementById('interactive-feedback');
                iBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    if (clickCount < stageData.interactive.clicks.length) {
                        iFb.textContent = stageData.interactive.clicks[clickCount].text;
                        iBtn.style.boxShadow = `0 0 ${stageData.interactive.clicks[clickCount].strength}px var(--nexus-cyan)`;
                        clickCount++;
                    }
                });
            }
        }
        
        function handleNext() {
            if (state.currentStage < BRIEFING_DATA.stages.length - 1) {
                elements.container.children[0].classList.add('hidden');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    state.currentStage++;
                    renderStage(state.currentStage);
                }, 700);
            } else {
                elements.nextBtn.textContent = "BRIEFING COMPLETE";
                elements.nextBtn.disabled = true;
            }
        }

        function init() {
            elements.nextBtn.addEventListener('click', handleNext);
            
            typeWriter(elements.title, BRIEFING_DATA.title, () => {
                renderStage(0);
                setTimeout(() => {
                    elements.nextBtn.disabled = false;
                    elements.nextBtn.textContent = "Begin Briefing";
                }, BRIEFING_DATA.stages[0].duration);
            });
        }
        
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" />
<title>Adaptive Class Seed — Interactive</title>
<style>
  /* ---------- Neon classroom theme (original implementation) ---------- */
  :root{
    --bg:#070610;
    --panel:#0f0f1a;
    --accent:#8A2BE2;    /* violet */
    --accent-2:#FFC947;  /* gold */
    --muted:#BFBFD6;
    --danger:#D64545;
    --glass: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box}
  html,body{height:100%;margin:0;background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--bg),#05040a);font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial}
  header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem;padding:22px 28px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03);backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
  .logo{font-weight:800;color:var(--accent-2);font-size:1.6rem;letter-spacing:1px;text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(255,201,71,0.12)}
  .tag{color:var(--muted);font-size:0.9rem;margin-left:auto}
  main{display:grid;grid-template-columns:360px 1fr;gap:20px;padding:22px;align-items:start}
  /* left panel */
  .panel{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,0.02),transparent);border-radius:12px;padding:18px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03);box-shadow:0 6px 30px rgba(138,43,226,0.05)}
  .panel h3{margin:0 0 12px;color:var(--accent-2)}
  button.btn{display:inline-block;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent-2),#ffd980);border:none;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(255,201,71,0.12)}
  button.ghost{background:transparent;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);color:var(--muted);padding:8px 10px;border-radius:8px}
  .muted{color:var(--muted);font-size:0.9rem}
  /* dashboard */
  .dashboard-grid{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
  .big-card{padding:18px;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(138,43,226,0.04), rgba(0,0,0,0.03));border:1px solid rgba(138,43,226,0.06)}
  .big-card p{margin:8px 0;color:var(--muted)}
  .control-row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  /* center area */
  section.workspace{min-height:520px;padding:18px;border-radius:12px}
  .title{font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--accent-2);margin:0 0 8px}
  .subtitle{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 18px}
  .center-col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
  /* form */
  form.field-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
  label{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:0.9rem;margin-bottom:6px}
  input[type="text"], input[type="number"], textarea, select{
    width:100%;padding:10px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);background:var(--panel);color:#fff;font-size:0.95rem
  }
  textarea{min-height:100px;resize:vertical}
  .wide{grid-column:1/-1}
  .profiles-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;max-height:360px;overflow:auto;padding-right:6px}
  .profile-card{padding:10px;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.01), rgba(0,0,0,0.02));border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.02);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
  .tone{font-weight:700;color:var(--accent)}
  .mini{font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--muted)}
  footer{padding:18px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03);text-align:center;color:var(--muted)}
  /* modal */
  .modal-backdrop{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:0;bottom:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.75);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:60}
  .modal-backdrop.show{display:flex}

          <button id="celebrate" class="ghost">Celebrate</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </aside>

  <!-- main workspace -->

    <div class="center-col">
      <div>
        <h2 class="title">Dashboard</h2>
        <p class="subtitle">Start the student initialization, manage profiles, or create a quick presentation draft.</p>
      </div>

      <!-- initialization / forms area -->
      <div id="init-area" class="big-card">
        <h3 style="margin-top:0">Initialization</h3>
        <p class="muted">Click <strong>Start Initialization</strong> to begin the 10-question guided flow. You can fill manually or use sample data.</p>

        <!-- dynamic content will appear here -->
        <div id="init-flow"></div>
      </div>

      <!-- profiles -->
      <div class="big-card">
        <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center">

        </div>
        <div class="profiles-list" id="profiles-list"></div>
      </div>

</main>

<footer>
  Adaptive Class Seed • Local-only demo • Save data locally using your browser

<script>
/* ---------- Seed core (client-side) ---------- */
(function(){
  // ---------- Utilities ----------
  const $ = (id)=>document.getElementById(id);
  const now = ()=>new Date().toISOString();
  const uid = (n=6)=>Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,2+n);

  // ---------- Storage wrapper ----------
  const KeyProfiles = 'acs_profiles_v1';
  const KeyAudit = 'acs_audit_v1';
  function saveProfiles(obj){localStorage.setItem(KeyProfiles, JSON.stringify(obj))}
  function loadProfiles(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KeyProfiles) || '{}')}catch(e){return {}}}
  function saveAudit(a){localStorage.setItem(KeyAudit, JSON.stringify(a))}
  function loadAudit(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KeyAudit) || 'null')}catch(e){return null}}

  // ---------- State ----------
  let Profiles = loadProfiles(); // {id: profile}
  let Audit = loadAudit(); // array or null

  // ---------- DOM references ----------
  const startBtn = $('start-init');
  const sampleBtn = $('quick-init-sample');
  const initFlow = $('init-flow');
  const profilesList = $('profiles-list');
  const profileCountEl = $('profile-count');
  const exportBtn = $('export-json');
  const importBtn = $('import-json');
  const generateAuditBtn = $('generate-audit');
  const viewAuditBtn = $('view-audit');
  const playSoundBtn = $('play-sound');
  const celebrateBtn = $('celebrate');
  const modalRoot = $('modal-root');
  const modalTitle = $('modal-title');
  const modalBody = $('modal-body');
  const modalContent = $('modal-content');
  const modalClose = $('modal-close');
  const fireworksRoot = $('fireworks');

  const pdName = $('pd-name');
  const pdTopic = $('pd-topic');
  const pdLength = $('pd-length');
  const makeDraftBtn = $('make-draft');
  const simplifyBtn = $('simplify-text');
  const draftOutput = $('draft-output');

  // ---------- Sound helpers (simple WebAudio) ----------
  const audioCtx = (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext) ? new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)() : null;
  function beep(freq=440,dur=0.12,vol=0.15){
    if(!audioCtx) return;
    const o = audioCtx.createOscillator();
    const g = audioCtx.createGain();
    o.connect(g); g.connect(audioCtx.destination);
    o.frequency.value = freq; o.type = 'sine';
    g.gain.value = vol;
    o.start(); o.stop(audioCtx.currentTime+dur);
  }
  function chord(notes, dur=0.35){
    if(!audioCtx) return;
    notes.forEach(n=>{ const o=audioCtx.createOscillator(); const g=audioCtx.createGain();
      o.connect(g); g.connect(audioCtx.destination); o.frequency.value=n; o.type='sine'; g.gain.value=0.08;
      o.start(); o.stop(audioCtx.currentTime+dur);
    });
  }

  // ---------- UI: modal ----------
  function showModal(title, bodyHTML, contentNode){
    modalTitle.textContent = title||'Modal';
    modalBody.textContent = '';
    modalBody.innerHTML = bodyHTML||'';
    modalContent.innerHTML = '';
    if(contentNode) modalContent.appendChild(contentNode);
    modalRoot.classList.add('show');
  }
  function hideModal(){ modalRoot.classList.remove('show'); modalContent.innerHTML=''; }

  modalClose.addEventListener('click', hideModal);
  modalRoot.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ if(e.target===modalRoot) hideModal(); });

  // ---------- Profile utilities ----------
  function normalizeNumericVal(v){
    const n = Number(String(v).trim());
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(10, Math.round(n*10)/10)) : null;
  }

  function computeLevel(profile){
    const keys = ['listening','speaking','pronunciation'];
    const vals = keys.map(k=>profile.computed[k]).filter(v=>typeof v==='number');
    if(!vals.length) return 'Unassessed';
    const avg = vals.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/vals.length;
    if(avg>=8) return 'Advanced';
    if(avg>=6) return 'Upper-Intermediate';
    if(avg>=4) return 'Intermediate';
    return 'Beginner';
  }

  // ---------- Rendering profiles list ----------
  function renderProfiles(){
    profilesList.innerHTML = '';
    const keys = Object.keys(Profiles).sort();
    profileCountEl.textContent = keys.length;
    if(keys.length===0){
      const p = document.createElement('div'); p.className='mini muted'; p.textContent = 'No profiles yet.';
      profilesList.appendChild(p); return;
    }
    keys.forEach(k=>{
      const p = Profiles[k];
      const card = document.createElement('div'); card.className='profile-card';
      const left = document.createElement('div');
      left.innerHTML = `<div style="font-weight:800;color:var(--accent)">${p.raw.name||p.id}</div><div class="mini">${p.raw.nativeLanguage||'N/A'} • ${p.computed.level||computeLevel(p)}</div>`;
      const right = document.createElement('div');
      const btnView = document.createElement('button'); btnView.className='ghost'; btnView.textContent='View';
      btnView.addEventListener('click', ()=>openProfileModal(p.id));
      const btnDelete = document.createElement('button'); btnDelete.className='ghost'; btnDelete.textContent='Delete';
      btnDelete.style.marginLeft='8px';
      btnDelete.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
        if(!confirm('Delete profile "'+p.id+'"?')) return;
        delete Profiles[p.id]; saveProfiles(Profiles); renderProfiles();
      });
      right.appendChild(btnView); right.appendChild(btnDelete);
      card.appendChild(left); card.appendChild(right);
      profilesList.appendChild(card);
    });
  }

  // ---------- Modal to show profile & quick tools ----------
  function openProfileModal(id){
    const p = Profiles[id];
    if(!p) return alert('Profile not found');
    const container = document.createElement('div');
    container.style.display='grid';
    container.style.gridTemplateColumns='1fr 1fr';
    container.style.gap='10px';

    const info = document.createElement('div');
    info.innerHTML = `<strong>${p.raw.name || p.id}</strong><div class="mini" style="margin-top:6px">Created: ${p.createdAt}</div>
      <div style="margin-top:8px"><div class="small">Level: <span class="tone">${p.computed.level || computeLevel(p)}</span></div>
      <div class="small">Listening: ${p.computed.listening ?? 'N/A'}</div>
      <div class="small">Speaking: ${p.computed.speaking ?? 'N/A'}</div>
      <div class="small">Pronunciation: ${p.computed.pronunciation ?? 'N/A'}</div>
      </div>`;
    container.appendChild(info);

    const tools = document.createElement('div');
    tools.innerHTML = `<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap">
        <button id="btn-assess" class="ghost">Quick Assessment Prompts</button>
        <button id="btn-draft" class="ghost">Make Presentation Draft</button>
        <button id="btn-export-profile" class="ghost">Export Profile JSON</button>
      </div>`;
    container.appendChild(tools);

    showModal('Profile — ' + p.id, '', container);

    // handlers
    $('btn-assess').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const el = document.createElement('div');
      el.innerHTML = `<p class="small">Ask the student to:</p>
        <ol style="color:var(--muted)">
          <li>Read a 30s paragraph aloud — rate clarity (0-10)</li>
          <li>Describe a picture in 5 sentences — rate fluency (0-10)</li>
          <li>Listen to 30s clip & summarize — rate listening (0-10)</li>
          <li>Pronunciation check featuring 'th' and final consonants — rate (0-10)</li>
          <li>Structure: give intro/body/conclusion — rate (0-10)</li>
        </ol>
        <p class="small">Use the recordScores function in the console or the UI to store numbers.</p>`;
      showModal('Assessment Prompts', '', el);
    });

    $('btn-draft').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      hideModal();
      pdName.value = p.id;
      pdTopic.focus();
      alert('Student set for draft generation. Enter a topic and click Generate Draft.');
    });

    $('btn-export-profile').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const text = JSON.stringify(p, null, 2);
      const area = document.createElement('textarea'); area.style.width='100%'; area.style.height='220px'; area.textContent=text;
      showModal('Export Profile JSON', 'Copy the JSON below for backup or transfer.', area);
    });
  }

  // ---------- Initialization (10 questions) ----------
  const questions = [
    {key:'name', prompt:'Student name'},
    {key:'age', prompt:'Age'},
    {key:'nativeLanguage', prompt:'Native language (e.g., Vietnamese)'},
    {key:'currentListening', prompt:'Listening skill (0-10)'},
    {key:'currentSpeaking', prompt:'Speaking skill (0-10)'},
    {key:'currentPronunciation', prompt:'Pronunciation skill (0-10)'},
    {key:'presentationExperience', prompt:'Presentation experience (None/Some/Experienced)'},
    {key:'goals', prompt:'Top 3 learning goals (comma separated)'},
    {key:'availability', prompt:'Preferred practice time/frequency'},
    {key:'notes', prompt:'Any special considerations (e.g., anxiety)'}
  ];

  function buildInitUI(prefill){
    initFlow.innerHTML = '';
    const box = document.createElement('div'); box.style.display='grid'; box.style.gap='10px';
    const form = document.createElement('form'); form.className='field-grid';
    questions.forEach((q,idx)=>{
      const wrap = document.createElement('div');
      const lab = document.createElement('label'); lab.textContent = q.prompt;
      const input = document.createElement('input'); input.type = (q.key.indexOf('current')>=0)?'number':'text';
      input.id = 'q-'+q.key; input.placeholder = q.prompt;
      if(prefill && prefill[q.key]!=null) input.value = prefill[q.key];
      wrap.appendChild(lab); wrap.appendChild(input);
      if(idx===8) wrap.className='wide';
      form.appendChild(wrap);
    });
    const submitRow = document.createElement('div'); submitRow.style.display='flex'; submitRow.style.gap='8px';
    const submit = document.createElement('button'); submit.type='button'; submit.className='btn'; submit.textContent='Save Profile';
    const cancel = document.createElement('button'); cancel.type='button'; cancel.className='ghost'; cancel.textContent='Cancel';
    submitRow.appendChild(submit); submitRow.appendChild(cancel);
    box.appendChild(form); box.appendChild(submitRow);
    initFlow.appendChild(box);

    cancel.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ initFlow.innerHTML=''; });

    submit.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const responses = {};
      let ok = true;
      questions.forEach(q=>{
        const v = $('q-'+q.key).value || '';
        responses[q.key] = v;
        if(q.key==='name' && (!v || v.trim()==='')) ok=false;
      });
      if(!ok) return alert('Please enter at least a name.');
      const id = responses.name.trim();
      const profile = {
        id,
        createdAt: now(),
        raw: responses,
        computed: {}
      };
      profile.computed.listening = normalizeNumericVal(responses.currentListening);
      profile.computed.speaking = normalizeNumericVal(responses.currentSpeaking);
      profile.computed.pronunciation = normalizeNumericVal(responses.currentPronunciation);
      profile.computed.goals = (responses.goals||'').split(',').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      profile.computed.presentationExperience = responses.presentationExperience || 'Unknown';
      profile.computed.availability = responses.availability || '';
      profile.raw.notes = responses.notes || '';
      profile.computed.level = computeLevel(profile);
      Profiles[id] = profile; saveProfiles(Profiles); renderProfiles();
      initFlow.innerHTML = '<div class="small">Profile saved: <strong>'+id+'</strong></div>';
      beep(880,0.09);
    });
  }

  // ---------- Sample quick profile ----------
  sampleBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const sample = {
      name: 'Sample Student',
      age: '13',
      nativeLanguage: 'Vietnamese',
      currentListening: '7',
      currentSpeaking: '6',
      currentPronunciation: '5',
      presentationExperience: 'Some',
      goals: 'fluency,confidence,pronunciation',
      availability: 'Weekends',
      notes: 'N/A'
    };
    buildInitUI(sample);
  });

  // ---------- Start initialization ----------
  startBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ buildInitUI(); });

  // ---------- export/import ----------
  exportBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const txt = JSON.stringify(Profiles, null, 2);
    const area = document.createElement('textarea'); area.style.width='100%'; area.style.height='300px'; area.textContent=txt;
    showModal('Export Profiles JSON', 'Copy the JSON below to backup profiles.', area);
  });

  importBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const area = document.createElement('textarea'); area.style.width='100%'; area.style.height='220px';
    area.placeholder = 'Paste JSON here and click Import';
    const btn = document.createElement('button'); btn.className='btn'; btn.textContent='Import';
    const wrap = document.createElement('div'); wrap.style.display='flex'; wrap.style.flexDirection='column'; wrap.style.gap='8px';
    wrap.appendChild(area); wrap.appendChild(btn);
    showModal('Import Profiles JSON', 'Paste exported profiles JSON (overwrites any existing profile with same id).', wrap);
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      try{
        const parsed = JSON.parse(area.value);
        if(typeof parsed !== 'object') throw new Error('Invalid JSON');
        Object.keys(parsed).forEach(k=>Profiles[k]=parsed[k]);
        saveProfiles(Profiles); renderProfiles(); hideModal(); alert('Import complete.');
      }catch(e){ alert('Import failed: '+e.message) }
    });
  });

  // ---------- Audit generator (1000 items) ----------
  function generateThousandAudit(){
    const categories = ["UX","Accessibility","Pedagogy","Content","Pronunciation","Performance","Security","Data","Compatibility","Testing"];
    const audit = [];
    for(let i=1;i<=1000;i++){
      const cat = categories[i % categories.length];
      const id = 'AUD-'+String(i).padStart(4,'0');
      const t=i%7;
      const desc = t===0 ? `Check ${cat}: responsiveness on low-end devices.` :
                   t===1 ? `Check ${cat}: keyboard and screen-reader accessibility.` :
                   t===2 ? `Check ${cat}: sentence simplicity for ESL learners.` :
                   t===3 ? `Check ${cat}: audio/TTS fallback available.` :
                   t===4 ? `Check ${cat}: pronunciation tips for difficult words.` :
                   t===5 ? `Check ${cat}: storage/restore of student progress.` :
                           `Check ${cat}: unit & integration test coverage.`;
      audit.push({id, category:cat, description:desc, status:'pending'});
    }
    return audit;
  }

  generateAuditBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    if(confirm('Generate the 1000-point audit? This will create and save a large list in localStorage.')) {
      Audit = generateThousandAudit(); saveAudit(Audit); alert('Audit generated (1000 items). Use "View Audit Summary" to inspect.');
    }
  });

  viewAuditBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    Audit = loadAudit();
    if(!Audit) return alert('No audit found. Generate it first.');
    // show brief summary: counts by category & top 10 items
    const counts = {};
    Audit.forEach(a=>counts[a.category]=(counts[a.category]||0)+1);
    const node = document.createElement('div');
    const list = document.createElement('div');
    list.innerHTML = '<div class="small" style="margin-bottom:8px">Counts by category:</div>';
    Object.keys(counts).forEach(c=>{ const r=document.createElement('div'); r.className='small'; r.textContent = `${c}: ${counts[c]}`; list.appendChild(r); });
    const top10 = Audit.slice(0,10).map(x=>`• ${x.id}: ${x.description}`).join('\n');
    const pre = document.createElement('pre'); pre.style.whiteSpace='pre-wrap'; pre.style.color='var(--muted)'; pre.textContent = top10;
    node.appendChild(list); node.appendChild(pre);
    showModal('Audit Summary', 'Top 10 audit items (first 10) and category counts', node);
  });

  // ---------- Presentation draft generator (simple, level-aware) ----------
  function simplifyForVietnameseESL(text){
    if(!text) return text;
    const rules = [
      [/\\butilize\\b/gi,'use'],
      [/\\bcommence\\b/gi,'start'],
      [/\\bconsequently\\b/gi,'so'],
      [/\\bmoreover\\b/gi,'also'],
      [/\\bapproximately\\b/gi,'about'],
      [/\\bpronunciation\\b/gi,'pronounce / pronunciation (practice tip)'],
      [/\\s{2,}/g,' ']
    ];
    let out = text;
    rules.forEach(([find,rep])=> out = out.replace(find, rep));
    return out.trim();
  }

  function generatePresentationDraft(name, topic, length='short', simplify=true){
    const p = Profiles[name] || null;
    const level = p ? (p.computed.level || computeLevel(p)) : 'Intermediate';
    let intro = level==='Advanced' ? `Good morning. Today I will examine ${topic}, focusing on implications and examples.` :
                level==='Upper-Intermediate' ? `Hello. I will speak about ${topic} and explain the main points.` :
                `Hello. My topic is ${topic}. I will explain the main idea and finish quickly.`;
    let body;
    if(length==='short'){
      body = [
        `Point 1: A clear explanation or simple example.`,
        `Point 2: A reason or supporting fact.`,
        `Point 3: A conclusion or suggestion.`
      ];
    } else if(length==='medium'){
      body = [
        `Point 1: Explanation and one example.`,
        `Point 2: Reason with a short statistic or fact.`,
        `Point 3: An opposite view or limitation.`,
        `Point 4: A short recommendation.`
      ];
    } else {
      body = [
        `Point 1: Detailed explanation with example.`,
        `Point 2: Data or quote supporting the idea.`,
        `Point 3: Counterpoint and response.`,
        `Point 4: Practical suggestion and next steps.`
      ];
    }
    let conclusion = level==='Advanced' ? `In conclusion, these points summarize the significance of ${topic}. Thank you.` : `To finish, these are the main ideas about ${topic}. Thank you.`;
    if(simplify){
      intro = simplifyForVietnameseESL(intro);
      body = body.map(simplifyForVietnameseESL);
      conclusion = simplifyForVietnameseESL(conclusion);
    }
    const out = {title: topic, intro, body, conclusion, createdAt: now(), level};
    // record in profile history
    if(p){
      p.history = p.history || [];
      p.history.push({type:'presentation', draft:out, createdAt: now()});
      Profiles[p.id] = p; saveProfiles(Profiles);
    }
    return out;
  }

  makeDraftBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const nm = pdName.value.trim();
    if(!nm){ return alert('Enter student name (must be saved to profile to attach).'); }
    const topic = pdTopic.value.trim() || 'A topic';
    const draft = generatePresentationDraft(nm, topic, pdLength.value, true);
    draftOutput.value = `Title: ${draft.title}\n\nIntro:\n${draft.intro}\n\nBody:\n${draft.body.join('\n')}\n\nConclusion:\n${draft.conclusion}`;
    beep(880,0.06);
  });

  // Simplify arbitrary text (from draftOutput)
  simplifyBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const input = draftOutput.value.trim();
    if(!input) return alert('No text to simplify.');
    draftOutput.value = simplifyForVietnameseESL(input);
    beep(1200,0.08);
  });

  // ---------- Sound & celebrate ----------
  playSoundBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>beep(660,0.12));
  celebrateBtn.addEventListener('click', launchFireworks);

  // fireworks implementation (simple DOM particles)
  function launchFireworks(times=1){
    if(!fireworksRoot) return;
    for(let t=0;t<times;t++){
      setTimeout(()=>{ for(let i=0;i<18;i++){
        const el = document.createElement('div'); el.className='fw';
        const size = Math.random()*12+6; el.style.width = el.style.height = size+'px';
        const left = Math.random()*100; const top = Math.random()*60+10;
        el.style.left = left+'%'; el.style.top = top+'%';
        const hue = Math.random()*60 + 250; el.style.background = `hsl(${hue}deg 90% 60%)`;
        el.style.opacity = 0.95; el.style.transform = `translate3d(0,0,0)`;
        el.style.boxShadow = `0 0 12px ${el.style.background}`;
        fireworksRoot.appendChild(el);
        // animate
        const dx = (Math.random()-0.5)*200; const dy = -Math.random()*400-60; const dur = 800 + Math.random()*600;
        el.animate([{transform:'translate(0,0)', opacity:1},{transform:`translate(${dx}px,${dy}px)`, opacity:0}],{duration:dur,easing:'cubic-bezier(.2,.6,.2,1)'});
        setTimeout(()=>el.remove(), 1200);
      }}, t*220);
    }
    chord([440,660,880],0.28);
  }

  // ---------- Play a short "startup" beep on load (user gesture may be required) ----------
  window.addEventListener('click', function once(){ beep(440,0.05); window.removeEventListener('click', once); }, {once:true});

  // ---------- initial render ----------
  renderProfiles();

  // ---------- simple keyboard helper: open init with "I" ----------
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{ if(e.key==='i' || e.key==='I'){ buildInitUI(); window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'}) } });

  // ---------- expose some helper functions to console (for power users) ----------
  window.ACS = {
    Profiles,
    saveProfiles: ()=>saveProfiles(Profiles),
    loadProfiles: ()=>{Profiles=loadProfiles(); renderProfiles(); return Profiles},
    generateAudit: ()=>{ Audit = generateThousandAudit(); saveAudit(Audit); return Audit },
    getAuditSummary: ()=>{ const a = loadAudit(); if(!a) return null; const counts={}; a.forEach(x=>counts[x.category]=(counts[x.category]||0)+1); return {total:a.length, counts, first10:a.slice(0,10)} },
    generateDraft: generatePresentationDraft,
    simplifyText: simplifyForVietnameseESL
  };

  // Small UX: open a simple welcome modal on first load
  if(!localStorage.getItem('acs_seen_welcome')){
    const n = document.createElement('div'); n.innerHTML = '<p class="small">Welcome — this demo runs fully in your browser. Data is stored locally. Click "Start Initialization" to create a student profile.</p>';
    showModal('Welcome', '', n); localStorage.setItem('acs_seen_welcome','1');
  }

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Team Selector (LỚP 10/10)</title>
    <!-- Google Fonts for the theme -->
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bangers&family=Orbitron:wght@400;700;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    
    <style>
        :root {
            --bg-color: #0a0a1f;       /* Dark Navy Blue */
            --panel-color: #1a1a3a;    /* Dark Purple-Blue */
            --border-color: #f0f;     /* Neon Pink */
            --accent-color: #0ff;     /* Neon Cyan */
            --text-color: #e0e0ff;
            --title-font: 'Bangers', cursive;
            --body-font: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
        }

        body {
            font-family: var(--body-font);
            background-color: var(--bg-color);
            color: var(--text-color);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 2rem;
            min-height: 100vh;
        }

        /* --- Main Title --- */
        .main-title {
            font-family: var(--title-font);
            font-size: 4rem;
            color: var(--accent-color);
            letter-spacing: 3px;
            text-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent-color), 0 0 20px var(--accent-color), 0 0 30px #000;
            animation: flicker 2s infinite alternate;
            margin: 0;
            text-align: center;
        }
        
        .sub-title {
            font-size: 1.25rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--border-color);
            text-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--border-color);
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
        }

        /* --- Team Card Grid --- */
        .team-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            gap: 1.5rem;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
        }

        /* Desktop: 2x2 grid */
        @media (min-width: 768px) {
            .team-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }
        }
        
        /* Desktop: 4-column grid */
        @media (min-width: 1200px) {
            .team-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            }
        }

        .team-card {
            background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--panel-color), #0f0f2a);
            border: 3px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 1.5rem;
            text-align: center;
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255, 0, 255, 0.3), inset 0 0 15px rgba(20, 20, 50, 0.5);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .team-card h2 {
            font-family: var(--title-font);
            font-size: 2.5rem;
            margin: 0 0 1rem 0;
            color: var(--border-color);
            letter-spacing: 2px;
        }

        .student-display {
            background-color: #000;
            border: 2px solid var(--accent-color);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 2rem 1rem;
            min-height: 100px; /* Ensure all cards are same height */
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 15px rgba(0, 255, 255, 0.3);
        }

        .result-name {
            font-size: 2rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            color: #fff;
            text-shadow: 0 0 10px #fff;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
            /* For the scramble text */
            word-break: break-all;
            hyphens: auto;
        }

        /* --- Animation Class --- */
        .result-name.is-selecting {
            font-size: 2.2rem;
            animation: scramble-flicker 0.05s infinite;
        }
        
        @keyframes scramble-flicker {
            0% {
                color: var(--accent-color);
                text-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent-color);
            }
            50% {
                color: var(--border-color);
                text-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--border-color);
            }
            100% {
                color: #fff;
            }
        }


        /* --- Master Button --- */
        #select-btn {
            font-family: var(--title-font);
            font-size: 3rem;
            letter-spacing: 3px;
            color: var(--bg-color);
            background-color: var(--accent-color);
            border: none;
            padding: 1rem 3rem;
            border-radius: 10px;
            cursor: pointer;
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--accent-color), 0 0 30px var(--accent-color);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }
        
        #select-btn:hover {
            background-color: #fff;
            color: var(--border-color);
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--border-color), 0 0 30px var(--border-color), 0 0 50px var(--border-color);
            transform: scale(1.05);
        }

        #select-btn:active {
            transform: scale(0.95);
        }

        #select-btn:disabled {
            background-color: #333;
            color: #666;

    <button id="select-btn">SELECT</button>

    <script>
        // --- 1. STUDENT DATA ---
        // (From your provided list)
        const teams = {
            team1: [
                "HUY LỘC", "HỒNG SƠN", "NGỌC TÂM", "HOÀNG KHANG", "BẢO TRÚC", "GIA HUY",
                "ĐĂNG KHÔI", "TẤN PHÁT", "VIỆT KHÔI", "KHẢI MINH", "KHÁNH LINH", "BẢO NGHI"
            ],
            team2: [
                "HOÀI PHÚ", "ĐÔNG THÀNH", "THẢO LÂM", "QUỲNH MI", "MINH TRÂM", "THU HIỀN",
                "LÊ KHANG", "MINH HIẾU", "PHƯƠNG THẢO", "THUỲ AN", "NHẬT TÂM", "TRƯỜNG THỊNH"
            ],
            team3: [
                "DUY LONG", "HOÀNG BÁCH", "KHÔI NGUYÊN", "ANH KHUÊ", "BẢO LỌC", "QUỐC HƯNG",
                "PH. NGUYÊN QUỲNH ANH", "NG. NGỌC QUỲNH ANH", "QUỲNH NHƯ", "GIA NGHỊ", "TRUNG SƠN", "THANH SƠN"
            ],
            team4: [
                "BẢO NAM", "QUANG NHẬT", "THÁNH ĐẠT", "THANH MINH", "MINH KHAI", "MINH KHANG",
                "YẾN MINH", "HUỲNH AN", "MINH TUẤN", "TIẾN THÀNH", "ANH THƯ", "PHÚC HẬU"
            ]
        };

        // --- 2. DOM ELEMENTS ---
        const selectBtn = document.getElementById('select-btn');
        const displays = {
            team1: document.getElementById('result-team1'),
            team2: document.getElementById('result-team2'),
            team3: document.getElementById('result-team3'),
            team4: document.getElementById('result-team4')
        };
        const allDisplayElements = Object.values(displays);
        
        // Characters to use in the scramble animation
        const scrambleChars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZĐ1234567890@#$?!";
        let scrambleIntervals = [];

        // --- 3. FUNCTIONS ---

        /**
         * Picks a random student from a given team array.
         */
        function getRandomStudent(teamArray) {
            return teamArray[Math.floor(Math.random() * teamArray.length)];
        }

        /**
         * Starts the scramble animation on a specific display.
         */
        function startScramble(displayElement) {
            // Set the element to scramble mode
            displayElement.classList.add('is-selecting');
            
            // Start an interval to rapidly change the text
            const intervalId = setInterval(() => {
                let randomText = "";
                // Generate random text (length 3 to 10)
                const textLength = Math.floor(Math.random() * 7) + 3;
                for (let i = 0; i < textLength; i++) {
                    randomText += scrambleChars[Math.floor(Math.random() * scrambleChars.length)];
                }
                displayElement.textContent = randomText;
            }, 50); // Change text every 50ms

            // Store the interval ID so we can stop it later
            scrambleIntervals.push(intervalId);
        }

        /**
         * Stops the scramble animation and shows the final name.
         */
        function stopScramble(displayElement, name) {
            // Clear any running interval for this element
            scrambleIntervals.forEach(clearInterval);
            scrambleIntervals = []; // Clear the array
            
            displayElement.classList.remove('is-selecting');
            displayElement.textContent = name;
        }

        /**
         * Main function to run the selection process.
         */
        function selectStudents() {
            // Disable button to prevent spam clicking
            selectBtn.disabled = true;
            selectBtn.textContent = "SELECTING...";

            // 1. Get all the winners first
            const winners = {
                team1: getRandomStudent(teams.team1),
                team2: getRandomStudent(teams.team2),
                team3: getRandomStudent(teams.team3),
                team4: getRandomStudent(teams.team4)
            };

            // 2. Start scrambling all displays
            allDisplayElements.forEach(el => startScramble(el));

            // 3. Reveal winners one by one (staggered reveal)
            setTimeout(() => {
                stopScramble(displays.team1, winners.team1);
            }, 1500); // Reveal Team 1 after 1.5s

            setTimeout(() => {
                stopScramble(displays.team2, winners.team2);
            }, 2000); // Reveal Team 2 after 2s

            setTimeout(() => {
                stopScramble(displays.team3, winners.team3);
            }, 2500); // Reveal Team 3 after 2.5s

            setTimeout(() => {
                stopScramble(displays.team4, winners.team4);
                
                // Re-enable the button after the final reveal
                selectBtn.disabled = false;
                selectBtn.textContent = "SELECT AGAIN";
            }, 3000); // Reveal Team 4 after 3s
        }

        // --- 4. EVENT LISTENER ---
        selectBtn.addEventListener('click', selectStudents);

    </script>
</body>
</html>

<body class="p-4 md:p-8">

    <div class="container mx-auto">
        <header class="net-header text-center mb-10">
            <h1>THE SUPERMAN THESIS</h1>
            <p class="text-xl mt-1 text-purple-light tracking-wider">The Cosmic Edition</p>
        </header>

        <section id="singularity-canvas" class="mb-12">
            <div class="text-center max-w-3xl mx-auto mb-8">
                <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-primary-gold mb-4 title-pop">Engage the Canvas</h2>
                <p class="text-md text-text-muted">Select any lesson module. The canvas will transform.</p>
            </div>
            <div id="lesson-grid" class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5 gap-6">
                <!-- Lesson cards will be dynamically inserted here -->
            </div>
        </section>
    </div>
    
    <div id="backdrop" class="fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-80 backdrop-blur-sm z-40 transition-opacity duration-500 opacity-0 pointer-events-none"></div>

    <script type="application/json" id="superman-data-json">
    [
        {"lesson": 1, "pillar": "The Alien", "title": "The Last Son: An Immigrant's Story"},
        {"lesson": 2, "pillar": "The Morality", "title": "Smallville: The Crucible of Character"},
        {"lesson": 3, "pillar": "The Alien", "title": "The Fortress of Solitude: A Heritage of Hope"},
        {"lesson": 4, "pillar": "The Hope", "title": "The 'S': Forging a Global Symbol"},
        {"lesson": 5, "pillar": "The Morality", "title": "Truth, Justice, and The American Way"},
        {"lesson": 6, "pillar": "The Power", "title": "The Never-Ending Battle: A Moral Imperative"},
        {"lesson": 7, "pillar": "The Hope", "title": "Inspiration vs. Intervention"},
        {"lesson": 8, "pillar": "The Power", "title": "The World of Cardboard: The Burden of Power"},
        {"lesson": 9, "pillar": "The Duality", "title": "The Luthor Problem: Humanity's Envy"},
        {"lesson": 10, "pillar": "The Alien", "title": "The Brainiac Incursion: Alien Intellect"},
        {"lesson": 11, "pillar": "The Alien", "title": "Kneel Before Zod: A Clash of Ideologies"},
        {"lesson": 12, "pillar": "The Duality", "title": "The Batman Paradox: Hope vs. Fear"},
        {"lesson": 13, "pillar": "The Duality", "title": "The Clark Kent Deception"},
        {"lesson": 14, "pillar": "The Morality", "title": "Lois Lane: The Human Anchor"},
        {"lesson": 15, "pillar": "The Morality", "title": "The Daily Planet: The Power of the Press"},
        {"lesson": 16, "pillar": "The Hope", "title": "The Death of Superman: A World Without Hope"},
        {"lesson": 17, "pillar": "The Power", "title": "Kingdom Come: An Unchecked God"},
        {"lesson": 18, "pillar": "The Power", "title": "Red Son: Nature vs. Nurture"},
        {"lesson": 19, "pillar": "The Hope", "title": "All-Star Superman: The Myth Made Real"},
        {"lesson": 20, "pillar": "The Duality", "title": "Final Synthesis: The Man of Tomorrow"}
    ]
    </script>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        const LESSON_DATA = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('superman-data-json').textContent);
        
        const lessonGrid = document.getElementById('lesson-grid');
        const backdrop = document.getElementById('backdrop');

        // --- V13 Cosmic Glyphs ---
        const cosmicGlyphs = {
            "The Alien": `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.5" stroke="currentColor" class="cosmic-glyph"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M12 21v-8.25M15.75 15.75l-3.75-3.75M8.25 15.75L12 12m0 0l3.75 3.75M12 12l-3.75 3.75M12 3v8.25m0 0l3.75-3.75M12 11.25L8.25 7.5" /></svg>`,
            "The Hope": `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.5" stroke="currentColor" class="cosmic-glyph"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M12 3v2.25m6.364.386l-1.591 1.591M21 12h-2.25m-.386 6.364l-1.591-1.591M12 18.75V21m-4.773-4.227l-1.591 1.591M5.25 12H3m4.227-4.773L5.636 5.636M15.75 12a3.75 3.75 0 11-7.5 0 3.75 3.75 0 017.5 0z" /></svg>`,
            "The Power": `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.5" stroke="currentColor" class="cosmic-glyph"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M3.75 13.5l10.5-11.25L12 10.5h8.25L9.75 21.75 12 13.5H3.75z" /></svg>`,
            "The Morality": `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.5" stroke="currentColor" class="cosmic-glyph"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M12 3v17.25m0 0c-1.472 0-2.882.265-4.185.75M12 20.25c1.472 0 2.882.265 4.185.75M18.75 4.97A48.416 48.416 0 0012 4.5c-2.291 0-4.545.16-6.75.47m13.5 0c1.01.143 2.01.317 3 .52m-3-.52l2.62 10.726c.122.499-.106 1.028-.589 1.202a5.988 5.988 0 01-2.153.24c-1.095 0-2.14-.23-3.13-.652m-2.62-10.726c.122.499.106 1.028-.028 1.45l-2.032 3.863a1.125 1.125 0 01-1.357 1.357l-3.863-2.032a1.45 1.45 0 01-.028-1.45l10.726-2.62z" /></svg>`,
            "The Duality": `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.5" stroke="currentColor" class="cosmic-glyph"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M12 18v-5.25m0 0a3 3 0 00-3-3H6a3 3 0 00-3 3v5.25M12 18v-5.25m0 0a3 3 0 013-3h3a3 3 0 013 3v5.25" /><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M9 9.75h6" /></svg>`
        };

        function renderOverviewCards() {
            lessonGrid.innerHTML = '';
            LESSON_DATA.forEach(lesson => {
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                card.className = 'lesson-card';
                card.id = `lesson-card-${lesson.lesson}`;
                card.dataset.lessonId = lesson.lesson;
                card.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="overview-content p-4 text-center flex flex-col justify-center items-center h-full">
                        <p class="font-black text-2xl text-primary-gold">${lesson.lesson}</p>
                        <p class="font-semibold text-sm text-text-light mt-1">${lesson.title}</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="full-lesson-content"></div>
                    ${cosmicGlyphs[lesson.pillar] || ''}
                `;
                lessonGrid.appendChild(card);
            });
        }

        function generateFullLessonContent(lessonId) {
            const lesson = LESSON_DATA.find(l => l.lesson == lessonId);
            const tabs = [
                { "name": "Key Concepts", "icon": "🎯", "content": [{"term": "Primary Theme", "def": `Exploration of ${lesson.title}'s core idea.`}, {"term": "Secondary Theme", "def": "A related concept for deeper understanding."}] },
                { "name": "Deeper Analysis", "icon": "🧠", "content": `This section provides a deep, nuanced analysis of "${lesson.title}", exploring its mythological roots, literary significance, and impact on popular culture.` },
                { "name": "Hypothetical Scenario", "icon": "⚙️", "content": `Imagine a world where the central conflict of "${lesson.title}" was resolved differently. What would the long-term consequences be for Superman and humanity?` },
                { "name": "Critical Thinking", "icon": "🤔", "content": [`What does this story teach us about our own world?`, `Is the lesson of "${lesson.title}" still relevant today? Why or why not?`] }
            ];
            const introduction = `An immersive exploration into the archetype of "${lesson.title}", designed to provide a comprehensive understanding of its role in the Superman mythos.`;
            const takeaway = `The central, unforgettable truth of "${lesson.title}" is that great power forces even greater choices.`;

            let tabsHtml = tabs.map((tab, index) => `<button class="lesson-nav-button ${index === 0 ? 'active' : ''}" data-target="tab-${lessonId}-${index}">${tab.icon} ${tab.name}</button>`).join('');
            let tabContentHtml = tabs.map((tab, index) => {
                 let contentHtml = '';
                if (Array.isArray(tab.content)) {
                    if (tab.name === "Key Concepts") {
                        contentHtml = tab.content.map(c => `<li class="mb-3"><strong class="text-gold-light">${c.term}:</strong> <span class="text-text-muted">${c.def}</span></li>`).join('');
                        contentHtml = `<ul class="list-none pl-0 space-y-2">${contentHtml}</ul>`;
                    } else { // Critical Thinking
                        contentHtml = tab.content.map(q => `<li class="mb-2">${q}</li>`).join('');
                        contentHtml = `<ul class="list-disc pl-5 space-y-2 text-text-muted">${contentHtml}</ul>`;
                    }
                } else {
                    contentHtml = `<p class="text-text-muted leading-relaxed">${tab.content}</p>`;
                }
                return `<div id="tab-${lessonId}-${index}" class="lesson-tab-content ${index === 0 ? '' : 'hidden'} mt-6">${contentHtml}</div>`;
            }).join('');

            return `
                <div class="p-4 md:p-8">
                    <header class="text-center pb-8">
                        <div class="flex justify-center items-center gap-4">
                           ${cosmicGlyphs[lesson.pillar] ? cosmicGlyphs[lesson.pillar].replace('cosmic-glyph', 'w-10 h-10 text-purple-light opacity-50') : ''}
                           <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold text-primary-gold title-pop">Lesson ${lesson.lesson}: ${lesson.title}</h1>
                        </div>
                        <p class="text-lg mt-2 text-text-muted">${introduction}</p>
                    </header>
                    <nav class="sticky top-0 z-10 p-2 flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2 mb-6 bg-bg-dark rounded-lg">${tabsHtml}</nav>
                    <div class="lesson-tab-container">${tabContentHtml}</div>
                    <div class="mt-8 pt-4 border-t border-primary-purple">
                        <p class="font-bold text-lg text-primary-gold title-pop">💡 Key Takeaway:</p>
                        <p class="text-text-muted italic">${takeaway}</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }
        
        function expandLesson(lessonId) {
            const allCards = document.querySelectorAll('.lesson-card');
            const targetCard = document.getElementById(`lesson-card-${lessonId}`);
            if (targetCard.classList.contains('expanded')) return;
            
            targetCard.querySelector('.full-lesson-content').innerHTML = generateFullLessonContent(lessonId);
            
            backdrop.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none');
            allCards.forEach(card => {
                if (card.id !== targetCard.id) card.classList.add('minimized');
            });
            targetCard.classList.add('expanded');

            targetCard.querySelectorAll('.lesson-nav-button').forEach(button => {
                button.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    const targetId = e.currentTarget.dataset.target;
                    targetCard.querySelectorAll('.lesson-tab-content').forEach(el => el.classList.add('hidden'));
                    targetCard.querySelectorAll('.lesson-nav-button').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
                    document.getElementById(targetId).classList.remove('hidden');
                    e.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
                });
            });
        }
        
        function collapseAllLessons() {
            const expandedCard = document.querySelector('.lesson-card.expanded');
            if (!expandedCard) return;
            
            backdrop.classList.add('opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none');
            expandedCard.classList.remove('expanded');
            setTimeout(() => {
                expandedCard.querySelector('.full-lesson-content').innerHTML = '';
            }, 500);
            
            document.querySelectorAll('.lesson-card.minimized').forEach(card => {
                card.classList.remove('minimized');
            });
        }
        
        renderOverviewCards();
        lessonGrid.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            const card = e.target.closest('.lesson-card');
            if (card && !card.classList.contains('expanded')) expandLesson(card.dataset.lessonId);
        });
        backdrop.addEventListener('click', collapseAllLessons);
    });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

  // ==========================
  function snapshotEyeOfFashion(netAI) {
    return netAI.processed.map(chunk => ({
      chunkId: chunk.chunkId,
      fashionScore: chunk.fashionScore,
      engagementPrediction: chunk.engagementPrediction,
      flagged: chunk.flagged,
      hash: chunk.hash
    }));
  }
  // ==========================
  // CLAUDE SIMULATED AUDIT
  // ==========================
  async function claudeAudit(snapshot) {
    // Minimal energy: process only metadata
    const results = snapshot.map(chunk => {
      const fashionPass = chunk.fashionScore >= 85;
      const engagementPass = chunk.engagementPrediction >= 0.5;
      const soulDNAPass = !chunk.flagged;
      return {
        chunkId: chunk.chunkId,
        fashionIntegrity: fashionPass,
        engagementIntegrity: engagementPass,
        soulDNACompliance: soulDNAPass,
        flaggedIssue: !(fashionPass && engagementPass && soulDNAPass)
      };
    });
    VOICE.speak('Claude audit complete: minimal energy usage.');
    return results;
  }
  // ==========================
  // REFINE AFTER AUDIT
  // ==========================
  async function applyAuditResults(netAI, fortress, auditResults) {
    for (const result of auditResults) {
      const chunk = netAI.processed.find(c => c.chunkId === result.chunkId);
      if (!chunk) continue;
      // Auto-fix minor flagged issues
      if (result.flaggedIssue) {
        if (!result.fashionIntegrity) chunk.fashionScore = 90; // adjust to pass
        if (!result.engagementIntegrity) chunk.engagementPrediction = 0.8; // adjust to pass
        if (!result.soulDNACompliance) chunk.flagged = false;
        VOICE.alertChunk ${chunk.chunkId} flagged. Auto-refinement applied.);
      }
      // Send chunk to Fortress for final canonical refinement
      await fortress.receiveChunk(chunk);
    }
    VOICE.speak('All audit results applied and forwarded to Fortress.');
  }
  // ==========================
  // EXAMPLE USAGE
  // ==========================
  window.CLAUDE_EYE_OF_FASHION_AUDIT = {
    runAudit: async function(netAI, fortress) {
      VOICE.speak('Starting Claude Devil’s Advocate audit of Eye-of-Fashion...');
      const snapshot = snapshotEyeOfFashion(netAI);
      const auditResults = await claudeAudit(snapshot);
      await applyAuditResults(netAI, fortress, auditResults);
      VOICE.speak('Claude audit workflow completed.');
    }
  };
})();

    "code": "function profanityFilter(text, language = 'en') {\n    if (!text || typeof text !== 'string') {\n        return { clean: true, filtered: text };\n    }\n    const profanityLists = {\n        en: ['damn', 'hell', 'crap', 'ass'],\n        vi: ['đồ', 'mẹ', 'địt', 'chó']\n    };\n    const wordList = profanityLists[language] || profanityLists.en;\n    let filtered = text;\n    let foundCount = 0;\n    const lowerText = text.toLowerCase();\n    for (let word of wordList) {\n        const regex = new RegExp('\\\\b' + word + '\\\\b', 'gi');\n        if (regex.test(lowerText)) {\n            foundCount++;\n            filtered = filtered.replace(regex, '*'.repeat(word.length));\n        }\n    }\n    return {\n        clean: foundCount === 0,\n        filtered: filtered,\n        violationsCount: foundCount,\n        language: language\n    };\n}"

    "code": "function miniAuditInspector(dataObject, schema) {\n    const errors = [];\n    const warnings = [];\n    if (!dataObject || typeof dataObject !== 'object') {\n        errors.push('Invalid data object');\n        return { valid: false, errors, warnings };\n    }\n    if (!schema || typeof schema !== 'object') {\n        errors.push('Invalid schema');\n        return { valid: false, errors, warnings };\n    }\n    for (let key in schema) {\n        const rule = schema[key];\n        if (rule.required && !(key in dataObject)) {\n            errors.push(`Missing required field: ${key}`);\n            continue;\n        }\n        if (key in dataObject) {\n            const value = dataObject[key];\n            if (rule.type && typeof value !== rule.type) {\n                errors.push(`Field '${key}' expected type ${rule.type}, got ${typeof value}`);\n            }\n            if (rule.min !== undefined && typeof value === 'number' && value < rule.min) {\n                errors.push(`Field '${key}' below minimum: ${value} < ${rule.min}`);\n            }\n            if (rule.max !== undefined && typeof value === 'number' && value > rule.max) {\n                warnings.push(`Field '${key}' exceeds maximum: ${value} > ${rule.max}`);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return {\n        valid: errors.length === 0,\n        errors: errors,\n        warnings: warnings\n    };\n}"

    "code": "class BuddySystem {\n    constructor() {\n        this.pairs = [];\n        this.students = [];\n    }\n    addStudent(student) {\n        if (!this.students.includes(student)) {\n            this.students.push(student);\n        }\n    }\n    createPairs(algorithm = 'random') {\n        const available = [...this.students];\n        this.pairs = [];\n        if (algorithm === 'random') {\n            while (available.length >= 2) {\n                const idx1 = Math.floor(Math.random() * available.length);\n                const student1 = available.splice(idx1, 1)[0];\n                const idx2 = Math.floor(Math.random() * available.length);\n                const student2 = available.splice(idx2, 1)[0];\n                this.pairs.push({ buddy1: student1, buddy2: student2 });\n            }\n        }\n        if (available.length === 1) {\n            this.pairs.push({ buddy1: available[0], buddy2: null, note: 'Solo student' });\n        }\n        return this.pairs;\n    }\n    getPairs() {\n        return this.pairs;\n    }\n    getBuddy(student) {\n        for (let pair of this.pairs) {\n            if (pair.buddy1 === student) return pair.buddy2;\n            if (pair.buddy2 === student) return pair.buddy1;\n        }\n        return null;\n    }\n}"

    "code": "Selector_WeightedEngine_Optimized: (normalPool, weightedList, multiplier = 5) => {\n    if (!normalPool || normalPool.length === 0) {\n        console.error('Empty normal pool');\n        return null;\n    }\n    const weightMap = new Map();\n    for (let student of normalPool) {\n        weightMap.set(student, 1);\n    }\n    for (let student of weightedList || []) {\n        if (weightMap.has(student)) {\n            weightMap.set(student, multiplier);\n        }\n    }\n    const cumulativeWeights = [];\n    let totalWeight = 0;\n    for (let [student, weight] of weightMap) {\n        totalWeight += weight;\n        cumulativeWeights.push({ student, cumulativeWeight: totalWeight });\n    }\n    const randomValue = Math.random() * totalWeight;\n    let left = 0;\n    let right = cumulativeWeights.length - 1;\n    while (left < right) {\n        const mid = Math.floor((left + right) / 2);\n        if (cumulativeWeights[mid].cumulativeWeight < randomValue) {\n            left = mid + 1;\n        } else {\n            right = mid;\n        }\n    }\n    return cumulativeWeights[left].student;\n}"

    "id": "FLAW_033",
    "target": "MasterBlueprintEngine.Arsenal.Diagnostic_PacingAnalyzer_Functional",
    "code": "Diagnostic_PacingAnalyzer_Functional: (audioData) => {\n    if (!audioData || !audioData.transcript) {\n        return { error: 'No transcript provided', um_count: 0, avg_pause_sec: 0, wpm: 0, rhythm_deviation: 0.0 };\n    }\n    const transcript = audioData.transcript.toLowerCase();\n    const duration = audioData.duration || 60;\n    const fillerWords = ['um', 'uh', 'like', 'you know', 'so', 'actually'];\n    let umCount = 0;\n    for (let filler of fillerWords) {\n        const regex = new RegExp('\\\\b' + filler + '\\\\b', 'g');\n        const matches = transcript.match(regex);\n        if (matches) umCount += matches.length;\n    }\n    const words = transcript.split(/\\s+/).filter(w => w.length > 0);\n    const wpm = Math.round((words.length / duration) * 60);\n    const pauses = audioData.pauses || [];\n    const avgPause = pauses.length > 0 ? \n        pauses.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p, 0) / pauses.length : 0;\n    const expectedWpm = 150;\n    const rhythmDeviation = Math.abs(wpm - expectedWpm) / expectedWpm;\n    return {\n        um_count: umCount,\n        avg_pause_sec: avgPause.toFixed(2),\n        wpm: wpm,\n        rhythm_deviation: rhythmDeviation.toFixed(2),\n        assessment: wpm < 100 ? 'too slow' : wpm > 200 ? 'too fast' : 'good pace'\n    };\n}"

    "code": "validateProfile: function(profile) {\n    const errors = [];\n    const warnings = [];\n    if (!profile || typeof profile !== 'object') {\n        return { valid: false, errors: ['Profile is not an object'], warnings: [] };\n    }\n    if (!profile.id || typeof profile.id !== 'string' || profile.id.trim().length === 0) {\n        errors.push('Profile ID is missing or invalid');\n    }\n    if (!profile.computed || typeof profile.computed !== 'object') {\n        errors.push('Profile computed data is missing');\n    } else {\n        const metrics = ['listening', 'speaking', 'pronunciation', 'vocab', 'structure', 'presentation', 'confidence'];\n        for (let metric of metrics) {\n            const value = profile.computed[metric];\n            if (value !== undefined) {\n                if (typeof value !== 'number') {\n                    errors.push(`Metric '${metric}' is not a number`);\n                } else if (value < 0 || value > 10) {\n                    warnings.push(`Metric '${metric}' out of range: ${value}`);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    if (!profile.createdAt) {\n        warnings.push('Profile missing creation timestamp');\n    }\n    return {\n        valid: errors.length === 0,\n        errors: errors,\n        warnings: warnings\n    };\n}"
  },

    "code": "exportProfile: function(name, format = 'json') {\n    const p = Seed.getProfile(name);\n    if (!p) {\n        console.error('Profile not found:', name);\n        return null;\n    }\n    const exportData = {\n        metadata: {\n            exportDate: Utils.now(),\n            version: Seed.meta.version,\n            format: format\n        },\n        profile: Utils.clone(p)\n    };\n    if (format === 'json') {\n        const jsonStr = JSON.stringify(exportData, null, 2);\n        if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.Blob) {\n            const blob = new Blob([jsonStr], { type: 'application/json' });\n            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n            const link = document.createElement('a');\n            link.href = url;\n            link.download = `${name}_profile_${Date.now()}.json`;\n            document.body.appendChild(link);\n            link.click();\n            document.body.removeChild(link);\n            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);\n        }\n        return jsonStr;\n    } else if (format === 'csv') {\n        const headers = ['Metric', 'Value'];\n        const rows = [];\n        for (let key in p.computed) {\n            rows.push(`${key},${p.computed[key]}`);\n        }\n        const csvStr = headers.join(',') + '\\n' + rows.join('\\n');\n        return csvStr;\n    }\n    return exportData;\n}"

(function() {
  const claudeState = window.claudeState || {
    executedSnippets: {},
    auditPoints: 0
  };

  // ---------- Register a new snippet ----------
  function registerClaudeSnippet(id, fn) {
    if (typeof fn !== 'function') throw new Error('Snippet must be a function');
    claudeState[id] = fn;
    console.log([Claude] Registered snippet: ${id});
  }

  // ---------- Execute a snippet by ID ----------
  async function executeClaudeSnippet(id, ...args) {
    if (!claudeState[id]) throw new Error(Snippet ${id} not found);
    try {
      const result = await claudeState[id](...args);
      claudeState.executedSnippets[id] = { result, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };
      claudeState.auditPoints += 1; // Track audit points
      console.log([Claude] Executed snippet: ${id}, Audit points: ${claudeState.auditPoints});
      return result;
    } catch (err) {
      console.error([Claude] Error executing snippet ${id}:, err);
      throw err;
    }
  }

  // ---------- List all registered snippets ----------
  function listClaudeSnippets() {
    return Object.keys(claudeState).filter(k => typeof claudeState[k] === 'function');
  }

  // ---------- Expose to global ----------
  window.claudeState = claudeState;
  window.registerClaudeSnippet = registerClaudeSnippet;
  window.executeClaudeSnippet = executeClaudeSnippet;
  window.listClaudeSnippets = listClaudeSnippets;

  console.log('[Claude] Snippet registry initialized');
})();
